units: metres; size/aabb_center/markers in Godot axes (x right, y up, z back); origin = base centre on ground; front faces -Z (Blender +Y)
collision_notes: none: no collider (foliage/ground cover/overhead dressing). cylinder: radius, from y=0 to height, centred on origin or, when 'offsets' is present, one cylinder per offset (e.g. gate posts; the gap stays open). box: size + center in prop-local Godot coordinates. Tree cylinders cover the trunk only.
